name: get_status
title: Status
description: Whose rvrs account this agent reads, what it holds and what the agent may read. It counts the runs, the installs by product (the iPhone and iPad app, the CLI, nodes and agents) and the nodes online. Call it first in a conversation. Safe to repeat.

link.description: The page on the web app, for the person who is signed in.

installs.description: The installs of the account that are not revoked, by product.

name: find_runs
title: Find Runs
description: The runs of this account, newest first, as one line each: tool, target, origin, outcome and summary, with a link. Filters combine: tool, target, part of a target, the device or node a run came from, a tag selector, how it was started, its outcome, loss, a window, a case and saved runs. With like, it lists the runs to compare one run with. For figures over many runs, summarize_runs reads less. Safe to repeat.

target.description: A target as it was typed, such as example.com or 1.1.1.1, without regard to case.

install.description: Where the runs were made: a device or a node, by its name or id.

tags.description: A selector on the tags the origin had: isp=telia, isp!=telia, isp, !isp, line in (ftth,cable), joined by commas to mean and.

loss.description: True for the runs that lost at least one probe.

like.description: A run to compare with: the runs with its tool, target, origin, destination address and IP family, without it.

cursor.description: The cursor of the page before.

address.description: The address the target resolved to.

link.description: The page on the web app, for the person who is signed in.
Runs on the web app with the same filters.

name: get_run
title: Run
description: One run of this account: its status line, figures, the path hop by hop, DNS sources and records, and rvrs’s interpretation, worded as an inference. brief, the default, leaves out each probe and full has them. A run asked of a node that hasn’t ended is waited for up to 30 seconds and answered with where it stands. Agents that draw show the result as the web app does. Safe to repeat.

detail.description: brief, unless given, leaves out each probe. full has every sample and record.

link.description: The page on the web app, for the person who is signed in.

name: list_nodes
title: Nodes
description: The nodes of this workspace by name, all or those a tag selector matches: online or not, when the API last heard from each, its rvrs version, its build features and its tags. A node is a machine elsewhere that runs rvrs and makes runs for the workspace. Safe to repeat.

tags.description: A selector on the nodes’ tags, as find_runs takes it.

link.description: The page on the web app, for the person who is signed in.

name: compare_runs
title: Compare Runs
description: Two to six runs side by side, the first as the baseline. It says first what the runs do not share (tool, target, destination address, IP family, origin, probe count), then each figure with its distance from the baseline, and the hop where each path leaves the baseline’s. Safe to repeat.

ids.description: The runs to compare, the first as the baseline the others are measured against.

address.description: The address the target resolved to.

link.description: The page on the web app, for the person who is signed in.

differs.description: What the runs do not share. Figures compare like with like only where this is empty.

values.description: One per run, in order. delta is the distance from the baseline.

paths.description: For each run after the baseline, the first TTL where its path leaves the baseline’s. Null when no hop differs.

name: summarize_runs
title: Summarize Runs
description: The runs of the past 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days, grouped by the device or node they came from or by target, each against the window before: runs, median latency, jitter, loss and failures, and why a group is worth a look. Then latency, jitter and loss over time for ping, traceroute and MTR, narrowed by tool, origin and target. These are the figures Overview shows on the web app. Safe to repeat.

install.description: Narrows the latency over time, by name or id.

runsBefore.description: Runs in the window of the same length before.

id.description: The install’s id, when the runs are grouped by install.

median.description: Median of the runs’ average round trips, in ms.

loss.description: The average share of probes lost, in percent.

worthALook.description: Why the group is worth a look: failed runs, loss, or latency up.

link.description: The page on the web app, for the person who is signed in.

points.description: The steps that had a ping, traceroute or MTR, oldest first.
